courseJsonLd.name: Job Safety and Environmental Analysis (JSEA) Course
courseJsonLd.description: A Job Safety and Environmental Analysis (JSEA) is a dynamic, task-specific hazard identification and control tool used before starting work each day. Unlike a SWMS, a JSEA is completed by the crew on site and adapted to actual site conditions. This course covers how to complete a JSEA correctly and embed it as a daily practice in restoration operations.
